# HANSAN — Orchestrator (Cline-owned)

Enforces sequential ownership (§2): Cline defines route / module /
contract → Copilot implements presentation → Cline integrates + QAs.

Never assign Copilot and Cline to the same files simultaneously.
Architecture + behavior win over visuals in any conflict (§28).
Phases: 0 foundation → 1 docs → 2 agents → 3 arch → 4 tokens →
5 primitives → 6 shell → 7 role access → 8 HQ → 9 POS → 10 KDS →
11 Finance → 12 Developer → integration → QA → freeze → backend → GitHub LAST.
